title: Fixed-stage coherent overlap comparison
statement: For the fixed-stage core data, a supplied coherent comparison diagram d [def-pc-two-open-comparison-diagram], overlap isomorphism e₀ and local identifications θU,θV with the limit object E, assume γU.symm.app A′ ≪≫ SP.mapIso θU ≪≫ τU.app E = HW.mapIso e₀ ≪≫ (γV.symm.app B′ ≪≫ SQ.mapIso θV ≪≫ τV.app E). Then γU.inv.app A′ ≫ SP.map θU.hom ≫ τU.hom.app E = HW.map e₀.hom ≫ γV.inv.app B′ ≫ SQ.map θV.hom ≫ τV.hom.app E. The hypothesis requires e₀ to induce the transition through E; compatibility is not asserted for an arbitrary e₀.

proof.text: Unfold perfectOverlapCoherenceStatement, then Apply congrArg Iso.hom to the supplied equality of isomorphisms. Rewrite homs of trans, symm, natural-isomorphism components, and mapIso; associate composition. This is the complete Lean proof and uses no geometric descent or realization lemma.

theorem perfect_overlap_transition_comparison_core_coherence
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapCoherenceStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage

old_proof.text: At the chosen stage, instantiate the two-open comparison diagram from the prescribed open restrictions. Descend the local identifications of the pulled-back perfect objects with the restrictions of E, transport them through the canonical derived-pullback composition and open-restriction comparison isomorphisms, and use naturality and the coherence of the canonical transport maps.
